findings.issue: Latency is stated as <5msP99 across scans/platforms. Performance docs scope benchmarks to desktopJVM; judge performance script claims median<5ms andP99<50ms.
findings.resolution: Use reported sub-5ms desktop-JVM engine median; exclude camera/UI/end-to-end andunmeasuredplatforms. Do not assert universalP99.

findings.issue: OfflineOnlyTest explicitly cannot block/monitor network; it checks completion/consistency/timing. Currentarticle saysscriptassertszerooutboundconnections.
findings.resolution: Keep locallydesignedanalysiscore; describe verify_offline as shared-engine unit checks, not independent network-traffic attestation or whole-app network guarantee.

findings.issue: 87%F1 is a repository-reported curated/synthetic URL corpus result. Other ML documentation reports conflicting0.905/0.96 scores.
findings.resolution: Attribute87% to README/EVALUATION curated corpus, no real-world/generalizationclaim; state source-metric inconsistency in audit, do not substitute larger metrics.

proposedPatch.description: Offline QR and URL analysis core built with Kotlin Multiplatform for five platform targets. Local heuristics and an ensemble model inspect URL patterns without a cloud lookup during analysis.
solution: Built a local URL-analysis core using Kotlin Multiplatform
Combined logistic regression, gradient boosting and decision rules with 25+ heuristic checks
Targeted 5 platforms (Android, iOS, JVM, JS, Wasm); the repository reports ~100% shared detection logic (~52% of total code)
Repository desktop-JVM benchmarks report sub-5ms median engine analysis; camera/UI latency and other platforms are outside that result
proof: Repository reports 87% F1 on a curated URL corpus; constructed patterns do not establish real-world detection accuracy
Performance evidence covers desktop-JVM engine analysis; sub-5ms median is not an all-platform or end-to-end P99 guarantee
Repository reports 1,248+ automated tests and 19 curated built-in red-team scenarios; counts were not rerun in this portfolio audit
./judge/verify_offline.sh invokes shared-engine unit checks; these tests are not an independent capture of outbound network traffic
Repository reports ~100% shared detection logic (~52% of total codebase)
measures: Local PhishingEngine analysis is designed without cloud URL lookups
Analysis does not require uploading the scanned URL
Offline unit checks exercise completion, determinism and timing; network interception is not independently verified

limits: No remote code executed or benchmarks independently reproduced.
ML source documentation internally inconsistent; conservative currentheadline attributed asreported.
